learning_outcomes.text: Apply inventory cost-flow methods (FIFO, weighted average) under IAS 2
Measure inventory at the lower of cost and net realisable value
Identify and account for slow-moving and obsolete stock
Design inventory provisioning and write-down policies
Analyse the financial-statement impact of inventory decisions

integrative_case: A retailer's accountant finds a warehouse full of aged seasonal stock before year end: age the inventory, decide which lines need a write-down to NRV, size a provision, and explain to the auditors and board the impact on profit and the balance sheet.
